policy: Every retained compiler, trim and AOT diagnostic must match a focused rule. This file suppresses nothing.

rules.rationale: The modern project targets tvOS 16.0; MonoPInvokeCallbackAttribute is supported on tvOS 12.2 and later. Stage 2 already executed these callback paths on device AOT.
rules.stage3BTest: retain the Stage 2 lifecycle/native callback self-tests when Celeste is integrated

rules.rationale: These are focused pre-existing diagnostics in the pinned FNA revision, not a modern-retarget or AOT closure failure.
rules.stage3BTest: exercise SDL event loops and representative compressed ContentManager reads without changing the pinned submodule

rules.rationale: The decompiled legacy code assumes complete FileStream reads; the warning is unrelated to trimming but requires content-load evidence.
rules.stage3BTest: load representative virtual textures and verify exact byte counts before first-frame acceptance

rules.rationale: Legacy PICO-8/FNA lowercase type names compile unchanged; the warning concerns possible future C# reserved names.
Two reconstructed nullable annotations appear in otherwise nullable-oblivious legacy source and do not alter emitted runtime semantics.
rules.stage3BTest: exercise tutorial GUI and atlas lookup through normal first-frame loading

rules.rationale: The exact supported binary decompiles with three dead local assignments; no source transformation is justified without runtime evidence.
rules.stage3BTest: exercise input, autotiling and wipe paths when reachable

rules.rationale: Private fields are populated through native marshaling in the exact managed FMOD 1.10.20 API. Native FMOD is intentionally absent until Stage 5.
rules.stage3BTest: unreachable while the explicit Stage 3A FMOD boundary is active; validate with exact native SDK only in Stage 5

rules.rationale: These fields belong to inactive Stadia/editor/cutscene or reconstructed state and are not trim/reflection diagnostics.
rules.stage3BTest: cover their owning feature only if the target startup path reaches it

rules.rationale: Settings is reachable before first frame and SaveData is required later; runtime XmlSerializer code generation cannot be assumed under full device AOT.
rules.stage3BTest: replace with a focused AOT-safe serializer path, then round-trip Settings and SaveData in ignored temporary storage on device

rules.rationale: This serializer is used only by a debug command that must remain disabled in the tvOS runtime lane.
rules.stage3BTest: prove the retail tvOS command console and Session export command are unreachable

rules.rationale: Static call-site inventory finds no normal startup use of SaveLoad and no concrete Calc serializer root; blanket preservation would be unjustified.
rules.stage3BTest: instrument startup and fail if either generic helper is reached before selecting a concrete serializer root

rules.rationale: Celeste discovers Oui, tracked/pooled entities, spawn/command methods and delegate targets from its own assembly. The generated reflection inventory records each site; a preserve-all descriptor is prohibited.
rules.stage3BTest: compare discovered type/method sets before and after trimming and add only exact roots proven necessary

rules.rationale: Pinned FNA constructs content readers, reflective members and vertex declarations dynamically. The content reader inventory narrows the user input to seven reader types.
rules.stage3BTest: load representative XNB files for all inventoried reader types and exercise the concrete vertex declarations under device AOT

rules.rationale: The pinned helper reflects AssemblyTitleAttribute while the platform trimmer removes attribute instances; the host supplies an explicit application title.
rules.stage3BTest: verify the title lookup fallback remains non-fatal when Celeste creates its FNA Game

rules.rationale: The platform XmlSerializer implementation reflects ObsoleteAttribute while the Apple trimmer removes it; this reinforces the explicit serializer blocker rather than justifying preserve-all.
rules.stage3BTest: resolve through the focused AOT-safe Settings/SaveData serializer work before first-frame acceptance
